cheap_substitution_token_accounting.caveat: Same-token repricing isolates list-price substitution only; it is not a causal counterfactual because model choice changes future tokens and trajectory length.

joint_success.criterion: router_resolved_count >= fixed_qwen_resolved_count and router_total_cost < fixed_qwen_total_cost and router_cheap_call_share >= 0.10 and routed_trajectories_with_cheap_call >= 30

all_three_arms.definition: Uses terminal held-out outcomes to choose the cheapest observed successful arm for each solvable task and the cheapest observed arm when none succeeded. It is an unattainable retrospective ceiling, not a deployable policy or causal cost estimate.

fixed_models_only.definition: Uses terminal held-out outcomes to choose the cheapest observed successful arm for each solvable task and the cheapest observed arm when none succeeded. It is an unattainable retrospective ceiling, not a deployable policy or causal cost estimate.
